location: Los Angeles, California · World Premiere Carpet
title: The Red Carpet Mogul
story: Dressed in a bespoke black shawl-collar tuxedo and open-neck silk shirt, Dwayne Johnson pauses before a wall of international press photographers. By this chapter of his career—balancing studio tentpoles, Seven Bucks Productions, and TKO Group board leadership—he had become one of Hollywood’s most bankable global ambassadors.

title: Forged in the Iron Paradise
story: Sweat-drenched in black MMA sparring gloves during his grueling conditioning camp to portray two-time UFC Heavyweight Tournament Champion Mark Kerr. For decades, Johnson’s 4 a.m. training sessions inside his traveling 'Iron Paradise' gym have anchored both his mental discipline and his physical transformations.

location: Ottawa, Canada · WWF Raw Is War
title: The Most Electrifying Man in Sports Entertainment
story: Throwing both arms skyward on the arena ropes at the height of the Attitude Era during a live broadcast of WWF Raw Is War. After reinventing himself from the clean-cut rookie Rocky Maivia into the brash, charismatic 'People’s Champion,' The Rock drove record television ratings and sold-out arenas worldwide.

title: Leading the Blockbuster Ensemble
story: In full costume as archaeologist-adventurer Dr. Smolder Bravestone alongside co-stars Karen Gillan, Kevin Hart, and Jack Black inside the vintage train car set. The Jumanji films grossed nearly $1.8 billion combined worldwide, showcasing his rare gift for self-deprecating physical comedy inside massive action set-pieces.

title: Honoring the Maivia & Samoan Lineage
story: Wearing a hand-woven traditional Hawaiʻian maile and ti-leaf lei in a quiet moment of reflection. As the grandson of High Chief Peter Maivia and Lia Maivia—and holding the noble Samoan chiefly title Seiuli bestowed in Apia—Polynesian culture, family, and faʻa Sāmoa remain the spiritual foundation of his life.

location: New York & Hollywood · Formal Gala Carpet
title: Bespoke Black-Tie & High Fashion
story: Arriving in a custom velvet-lapel formal tailcoat, crisp white pique waistcoat and bow tie, emerald lapel brooch, and diamond timepiece. His evolution into a fixture at the Academy Awards, Golden Globes, and international galas reflects his command of classic Hollywood tailoring.

title: Locker Room Roots with 'Soulman' Rocky Johnson
story: An archival black-and-white locker-room photograph of a young Dwayne Johnson—shortly after his #94 defensive tackle days at the University of Miami and the fateful $7 cut from the Calgary Stampeders—flanked by his father, WWE Hall of Famer 'Soulman' Rocky Johnson, and Tony Atlas.

location: Los Angeles · Apple Music & Seven Bucks Sessions
title: Seven Bucks Producer Behind the Mic
story: Inside the broadcast studio discussing storytelling, Polynesian music, and production slate strategy. Co-founded with Dany Garcia in 2012—named after the seven dollars left in his pocket when he left the CFL—Seven Bucks Productions has grown into a multi-billion-dollar film, television, and cultural studio.

location: Los Angeles & Jalisco Highlands · Destilería Teremana
title: The Entrepreneur & Teremana Founder
story: A classic black-and-white portrait in formal evening wear resting his hand on a bespoke oak aging barrel from Destilería Teremana de Agave. Launched in 2020 with a commitment to small-batch Highland Jalisco craftsmanship, Teremana shattered industry records as the fastest-growing spirits launch in history.

location: Venice Lido, Italy · 82nd Venice Film Festival
title: Venice Standing Ovation for The Smashing Machine
story: Arriving at the 82nd Venice International Film Festival for the world premiere of Benny Safdie’s A24 drama The Smashing Machine. That evening, Johnson’s raw dramatic performance as Mark Kerr earned a 15-minute standing ovation that brought him to tears and launched his first Golden Globe Best Actor nomination.

title: Rise of the Intercontinental Champion
story: Ringside in Manchester wearing the WWF Intercontinental Championship belt during his breakout 1998 run with the Nation of Domination. Just months after turning heel and speaking of himself in the third person, The Rock was rapidly ascending toward his first WWF World Heavyweight Championship at Survivor Series.

title: The Attitude Era Rivalry with Stone Cold
story: Sporting his signature dark sunglasses and carrying 'Stone Cold' Steve Austin’s custom Smoking Skull WWF Championship belt over his shoulder in Sheffield. His legendary trilogy of WrestleMania main events against Austin defined the most lucrative boom period in professional wrestling history.

location: Toronto, Ontario · WrestleMania X8 Fan Axxess
title: Commanding the Crowd on the Microphone
story: In the ring with microphone in hand at WrestleMania X8 Fan Axxess in Toronto, days before his historic 'Icon vs. Icon' clash against Hollywood Hulk Hogan in front of 68,237 fans at the SkyDome—while his first leading film The Scorpion King prepared to open in theaters.

location: Vancouver & Tokyo Set · The Smashing Machine
title: Between Rounds with Director Benny Safdie
story: A striking black-and-white ringside photograph capturing Johnson in full Mark Kerr prosthetics and Pride FC fight gear leaning across the ropes to confer with writer-director Benny Safdie between takes on the A24 biopic.

title: Becoming Mark Kerr: The Physical Transformation
story: An intimate close-up after hours in the prosthetics chair with Oscar-winning makeup artist Kazu Hiro, paired with months of heavy MMA grappling, trap development, and footwork drills to embody the 1990s no-holds-barred heavyweight icon.

title: The Samoan Peʻa & Family Crest
story: Completed over 60 hours in three 20-hour sessions by master tattooist Po’oino Yrondi in Hawaiʻi, Johnson’s intricate Samoan shoulder and chest tattoo tells the story of his family heritage, spiritual protection, and warrior ancestors.

title: Teenage Years with Ata & Rocky Johnson
story: A rare family portrait of a teenage Dwayne Johnson with his mother Ata Johnson and father Rocky Johnson. After facing eviction in Honolulu at age 14, he channeled his restless energy into the weight room and high school football gridiron in Bethlehem, Pennsylvania.

title: Homecoming in Oʻahu for Moana 2
story: Framed by flaming tiki torches and tropical orchids on the Oʻahu shoreline at the world premiere of Disney’s Moana 2. Voicing—and later playing in live action—the demigod Maui allowed Johnson to celebrate Polynesian voyaging culture on a billion-dollar global stage.

location: New York City · Private Atelier Fitting
title: Quiet Precision Before the Flashbulbs
story: A candid black-and-white frame inside the fitting room as master tailors make final adjustments to his custom white dinner jacket. Tailoring for his 6-foot-5, 260-pound frame requires custom patterns built from scratch for every major red carpet.

title: Backstage Brotherhood with Kevin Hart & Jack Black
story: Striding down a studio hallway in a burgundy leather jacket sharing a laugh with frequent co-stars Kevin Hart and Jack Black. Across five films together, his off-camera camaraderie with Hart became one of modern cinema’s most beloved comedic partnerships.

title: The Scorpion King Global Breakout Tour
story: A 29-year-old Dwayne Johnson smiling during his international press tour in Singapore for The Scorpion King (2002). Earning a Guinness World Record $5.5 million salary for his first solo starring role, he proved that a wrestling superstar could open a global studio tentpole.

title: Saluting Service Members at Edwards AFB
story: Wearing a U.S. Air Force woodland camouflage jacket while greeting airmen and military families at the Edwards Air Force Base theater—beginning a lifelong tradition of screening his films on military bases and visiting U.S. troops.

location: New York City · Tribeca Film Festival
title: The Transition Era at Tribeca
story: Photographed at the 2009 Tribeca Film Festival in New York. Soon after this period, Johnson made the pivotal career decision to overhaul his management team, return to intense strength training, and reclaim his authentic action-titan identity with Fast Five.

title: Franchise Catalyst: G.I. Joe & Fast 6 Era
story: On the world premiere red carpet in Sydney for G.I. Joe: Retaliation. In 2013 alone, Johnson headlined four studio releases—including Fast & Furious 6 and Pain & Gain—earning Forbes’ title of the highest-grossing actor in the world ($1.3B in a single calendar year).

title: Eight Months of Iron for Hercules
story: Smiling on the Hercules premiere carpet after completing an 8-month, 7-meal-a-day training and nutrition regimen in Budapest—pushing his physique to peak muscularity while filming even after tearing tendons in his pelvis and abdomen earlier that year.

location: The Beverly Hilton, Beverly Hills · Golden Globes
title: Golden Globes Ballroom with George Clooney
story: Sharing a warm moment inside the Beverly Hilton ballroom with George Clooney during Golden Globes weekend, celebrating a new era of auteur collaborations alongside Hollywood’s leading filmmakers.

title: Action Stunts in the Oʻahu Rainforest
story: Filming deep inside the Kualoa Valley rainforest on Oʻahu with Kevin Hart, Karen Gillan, and Jack Black—raising his signature People’s Eyebrow between rugged jungle stunt sequences.

location: Sydney Harbour, Australia · Global Press Junket
title: Through the Viewfinder at Sydney Harbour
story: Framed between cinema cameras and boom mics with the sails of the Sydney Opera House visible behind him, wearing a traditional woven lei during an international press day.

title: Official Visit to the Pentagon
story: Captured in a candid laugh while meeting with U.S. service members and defense leadership at the Pentagon in Arlington, Virginia—continuing his decades-long support for military personnel and veterans.

title: Gratitude Under the Arena Spotlights
story: Holding a bronze achievement statuette aloft with his trademark wide smile—reflecting on a journey that began with seven dollars in his pocket and grew into one of entertainment history’s most enduring legacies.
